name: Amber Riley
source:
Such a thoughtful soul... why hasn't Marty ever run into her before? Why does she spend her days wandering the parklands at the fringe of town? Why is her brother so desperately protective over her? So many questions... but she's not exactly forthcoming with the answers....

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
